question: What is the value of (X)/(Y), if frac{{X - 5Y}}{{X + 5Y}} = (7)/(8)?
solution:
**Given:**

frac{{X - 5Y}}{{X + 5Y}} = (7)/(8)

**Calculation:**

On dividing the numerator and denominator of the left hand side by Y, 

({frac{X)/(Y) - 5}}{{(X)/(Y)+ 5}} = (7)/(8)

On simplifying and solving for X/Y,

(8X)/(Y) - 40=(7X)/(Y)+ 35

(X)/(Y)= 40+35=75

**∴ The value of (X)/(Y) is frac{{75}}{1}**
